title: AI Engineer
job_description:
Role: AI Engineer

Location: Jakarta
Position Type: Full-time
Reports to: CTO




About the Role

We are seeking an ML Engineer to own the AI and machine learning capability within an established cross-functional team. You will be the subject matter expert on LLMs, document AI, and RAG pipelines — working alongside experienced software developers, data engineers, and database engineers.

The role has a clear long-term roadmap: helping shape the logic of our document crawler, building ML pipelines that extract and populate structured databases, and ultimately delivering an internal chatbot grounded in our own ground-truth data. You will be joining a collaborative team where software developers, data engineers, and database architects will help support the surrounding infrastructure. The ideal candidate would combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in web crawling, document AI, RAG pipelines, and LLM tool integration — and is comfortable taking a system from prototype to production.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with the software development and data engineering teams on the company document crawler — contributing to crawler logic, defining document targeting requirements, and advising on ML-driven enhancements to improve discovery, classification, and retrieval of company documents (annual reports, regulatory filings, press releases).

Develop and fine-tune workflows combining SLMs (small language models), LLMs, and rule-based methods for accurate and explainable data extraction.

Architect and build the chatbot interface that grounds LLM responses in our structured databases and PDF corpus, using RAG and MCP-based tool calling to ensure answers are traceable to source data.

Integrate relevant open-source tools across the full stack: crawling (Scrapy, Playwright), document parsing (pdfplumber, Camelot, Tabula, Docling), ML/NLP (Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector stores (Qdrant, pgvector), and LLM serving (Ollama, vLLM) — selecting self-hosted vs. API-based options based on data sensitivity requirements.

Implement evaluation frameworks (accuracy, latency, cost) and maintain benchmarks for extraction quality.

Ensure robust engineering practices: testing, version control, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud deployment.

Contribute to research and stay up to date with advances in document AI, new libraries and new techniques.

Qualifications

Education: BSc (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

Experience: 3+ years of professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, or NLP Engineer.

Technical Skills (Required):

Demonstrated experience building tools that leverage LLMs/SLMs for text and document understanding.

Experience building web crawlers or scrapers (e.g. Scrapy, Playwright, BeautifulSoup) including handling rate limiting, dynamic content, and document deduplication

Strong programming skills in Python

Experience with document parsing libraries (pdfplumber, Camelot, Tabula, or Docling) and an understanding of the challenges of table extraction, multi-column layouts, and scanned documents

Hands-on use of vector databases (e.g., Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate) for retrieval-augmented generation.

Strong background in software engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, testing)

Nice to Have:

Knowledge of financial or commodity reporting standards and typical document structures (annual reports, earnings releases, regulatory filings).

Experience deploying AI workloads in Microsoft Azure

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and building tool-calling integrations that connect LLMs to structured databases or document stores

Experience self-hosting LLMs locally using tools such as Ollama or vLLM, with an understanding of the trade-offs between local inference and cloud API usage

Familiarity with API design for ML deployment

Soft Skills

Ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders.

Excellent communication skills to explain AI model behaviour and limitations to non-technical teams.

What We Offer

Opportunity to build a greenfield AI product in the mineral economics domain.

Work with cutting-edge LLM and AI tools.

Modern, central office near to public transport and key amenities

Competitive salary

Foster a collaborative professional learning culture focused on inquiry, innovation, assessment literacy, and student agency.

Oversee the implementation and quality of the core components—Theory of Knowledge (TOK), Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS), and the Extended Essay (EE).

Advise students and parents on DP course selections, university applications, and academic pathways.

Communicate effectively with parents and guardians regarding DP curriculum, expectations, and student progress through meetings, workshops, and newsletters.

Build partnerships with universities, alumni, and external organizations to enrich the student experience and facilitate career and university readiness

Strong understanding of the IB DP Standards and Practices, and experience in curriculum planning, assessment, and reporting within the Diploma Programme.

title: Factory IT Business Analyst (BA)
company: 深圳市基克纳科技有限公司
job_description:
Job Description for Factory IT Business Analyst (BA)




II. Core Job Responsibilities




1. Business Research and Pain Point Identification: Go deep into the factory's production workshops and warehouse frontlines, fully familiarize yourself with the entire warehouse process of "receiving, storing, issuing, counting, and managing" (including purchase warehousing, production material picking, production material returning, sales outbound, inventory counting, etc.) and the entire production process (production order maintenance, bill of materials management, production reporting, production warehousing, etc.). Sort out the existing business processes, job responsibilities and collaboration models, accurately identify business pain points, bottlenecks and optimization spaces, and form a business research and analysis report.




2. Requirements Analysis and Document Conversion: Combine the results of business research, collaborate efficiently with business departments such as production, warehousing and purchasing, collect, sort out and analyze business requirements. Convert complex business scenarios and operation processes into clear, standardized and implementable IT requirement documents, including but not limited to Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), flow charts, use case diagrams, etc. Ensure that the requirement description is accurate, the logic is clear, it is consistent with the actual business scenario of the factory, and bridge the cognitive gap between the IT development team and the business departments.




3. Project Implementation and Requirement Control: Participate in the entire process of requirement review, solution design, test verification and launch promotion of factory IT systems (such as MES, WMS, ERP production/warehousing modules, etc.), follow up the progress of requirement implementation throughout the process, coordinate and solve the connection problems between business and IT during the project implementation, ensure that the system functions meet the business requirements, and improve business operation efficiency.




4. Process Optimization and System Iteration: Continuously track the operation effect of production and warehousing business processes and IT systems, put forward requirement optimization suggestions based on business changes (such as capacity improvement, process adjustment) and system usage feedback, and promote the iterative upgrading of IT systems; assist business departments in sorting out standardized business processes, realize "process reengineering" based on "online processes", and help improve business efficiency.




III. Job Qualifications




(I) Hard Requirements




1. Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer-related fields (Computer Science and Technology, Information Management and Information System, etc.), Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management and other related majors are preferred.




2. Work Experience: More than 3 years of relevant work experience as a factory IT Business Analyst (BA), must have business analysis experience related to factory warehouse management and production processes, be familiar with the entire process of factory production execution and warehouse management, and be able to independently complete business research, requirement analysis and requirement document writing.




3. Core Competencies: Possess strong requirement conversion ability, able to convert complex factory business scenarios (such as warehouse batch management, production material kitting analysis, inventory traceability, etc.) into standardized and implementable IT requirement documents; have clear logical thinking and problem analysis ability, able to quickly locate business pain points and put forward reasonable optimization solutions.




4. Successful Cases: At least 1 successful factory IT project case must be provided (which must include warehouse or production-related scenarios), clearly explaining the business analysis responsibilities undertaken in the project, the requirement conversion process and the project implementation results (such as quantifiable indicators such as process optimization efficiency, inventory accuracy improvement, energy consumption reduction, etc.), and the case must be true and traceable.

Kandidat yang ideal tidak hanya mahir dalam membangun aplikasi dari sisi frontend hingga backend, tetapi juga memiliki pemahaman mendalam mengenai manajemen infrastruktur modern menggunakan teknologi kontainerisasi dan orkestrasi.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

Merancang, mengembangkan, dan memelihara aplikasi web yang skalabel dan responsif.

Membangun API yang efisien dan mengintegrasikan layanan pihak ketiga.

Mengelola siklus hidup pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC) mulai dari konsep hingga implementasi.

Mengatur dan mengoptimalkan infrastruktur jaringan serta server menggunakan teknologi Docker dan Kubernetes.

Melakukan pemeliharaan rutin, troubleshooting, dan optimasi performa pada aplikasi maupun server.

Bekerja sama dengan tim untuk menentukan arsitektur teknis yang paling efektif.

Kebutuhan Teknis (Technical Skills)

Programming: Menguasai bahasa pemrograman terkini seperti Node.js, Python, Go, atau TypeScript.

Frontend: Mahir menggunakan framework modern seperti React.js, Vue.js, atau Next.js.

Backend: Berpengalaman dalam pengembangan RESTful API atau GraphQL.

Infrastructure: Pemahaman mendalam tentang Docker (Containerization) dan Kubernetes (Orchestration).

Cloud & Network: Familiar dengan layanan cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) serta konfigurasi jaringan (Load Balancing, DNS, VPN).

Database: Menguasai SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) dan NoSQL (MongoDB/Redis).

Version Control: Terbiasa menggunakan Git (GitHub/GitLab).

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.

Pengalaman minimal 2-3 tahun di posisi yang relevan.

Memiliki pola pikir problem-solving yang kuat dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

Mampu belajar dengan cepat terhadap teknologi-teknologi baru di industri IT.

Memiliki portofolio proyek yang pernah dikerjakan akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Wajib memiliki skill dan specialist untuk Kubernetes.
